_comment: Validin (app.validin.com) endpoint path templates + quota/cap budget for wp_validin.py. {q} is URL-encoded by the client. Community tier is 10 queries/day, 50/month — the budget caps keep one /cti run from emptying a small key. Overrides the inline _VALIDIN_FALLBACK; a missing/bad file degrades to that fallback with a warning.

endpoints._comment: axon/v2/profile REST paths joined to https://app.validin.com; {q} is the URL-encoded query value.

budget._comment: Quota thresholds: per-domain (sized for a 10/day Community key), per-run, and the min remaining before the quota gate trips. POLICY (project decision): `block_when_exhausted` is FALSE — the skill imposes no hard usage limit; a breached threshold is printed once as an advisory, the counters still advance, the call proceeds, and Validin's own 402/429 (handled tri-state) is the real limit. Set it true to degrade to `{"skipped": "quota"}` instead.
